newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Mexico's Telmex raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mexico's Telmex raised.

text.p: The Banacci brokerage said Monday it has raised its recommendation on Telifonos de Mixico SA de CV (Telmex) to buy from neutral.
"The price on Telmex is very attractive compared to similar businesses in Latin America," analysts Arturo Vazquez and Rafael Urquma wrote.
-- Banacci was comparing the Mexican phone company to counterparts in Chile, Argentina, Brazil and Peru.
-- Banacci said Telmex's L series, the heaviest weighted share on the Mexican bolsa, has fallen 10 percent this month even though the brokerage has maintained its year-end price target of 28 pesos.
-- Telmex L shares were trading down 18 centavos to 19.64 pesos in the early afternoon.
In New York, its ADRs were off 13/16 at 50-1/2.
